'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[November 2025 Israeli attack in Beirut]]
***[[Israel]] carries out an [[airstrike]] on a building in [[Beirut]], [[Lebanon]], killing five [[Hezbollah]] militants and injuring 28 others. Hezbollah military chief [[Haytham Ali Tabatabai]] is confirmed among the fatalities. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/23/israel-bombs-southern-suburbs-of-beirut (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[International Paderewski Piano Competition]]
**[[South Korea]]n pianist Roh Hyunjin wins the 13th International Piano Competition held at the [[Pomeranian Philharmonic]] in [[Bydgoszcz]], [[Kuyavian–Pomeranian Voivodeship|Kuyavia–Pomerania]], [[Poland]]. [https://portalkujawski.pl/2025/korean-pianist-roh-hyunjin-becomes-the-best-pianist-in-the-world-after-a-fierce-competition/ (Portal Kujawski)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*The death toll from the [[flood]]s in [[Central Vietnam|central]] [[Vietnam]] a week ago increases to 90 people. [https://apnews.com/article/vietnam-flood-rains-landslides-casualties-af29727651f5611fc2273f115a50416b (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The long-dormant [[Hayli Gubbi]] volcano erupts in the [[Afar Region]] of [[Ethiopia]] for the first time in nearly 12,000 years, sending ash plumes across the [[Red Sea]] towards [[Oman]] and [[Yemen]], and causing flight disruptions across the [[Arabian Peninsula]] and [[South Asia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/ethiopia-volcano-afar-hayli-gubbi-15232fa7dc1920f44a89e92699b845b1 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2026 United Nations Climate Change Conference]], [[Australia–Turkey relations]]
**[[Australia]] and [[Turkey]] confirm an agreement for Turkey to host the 2026 [[United Nations Climate Change Conference]] (COP31) in [[Antalya]], with Australia leading the conference's negotiation process and the [[Group of Asia and the Pacific Small Island Developing States|Asia–Pacific Group]] convening a pre-COP31 meeting focused on [[Climate change vulnerability|climate-related vulnerabilities]]. [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/cop/australia-pm-says-formal-deal-reached-turkey-host-cop31-climate-summit-2025-11-22/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Slender Man stabbing]]
**[[Law enforcement in Illinois|Police]] detain stabbing convict Morgan Geyser in [[Posen, Illinois|Posen]], [[Illinois]], [[United States]], after he removed his [[Electronic tagging|monitoring device]] and fled a supervised [[group home]] in [[Wisconsin]]. Geyser is returned to Wisconsin custody. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvgkwgyqzn0o (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/wisconsin-woman-convicted-slenderman-stabbing-captured-after-weekend-escape-2025-11-24/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections''' 
*[[2025 Guinea-Bissau general election]]
**[[Guinea-Bissau|Bissau-Guineans]] vote for a [[President of Guinea-Bissau|president]], with incumbent [[Umaro Sissoco Embaló]] seeking a second term. [https://apnews.com/article/guinea-bissau-presidential-election-umaro-sissoco-embalo-7f482e3d8b56246820e4ced91cb9856e (AP)]
*[[2025 Republika Srpska presidential election]]
**Citizens of [[Republika Srpska]], [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]], vote for a [[President of Republika Srpska|president]] to replace [[Milorad Dodik]], who was removed by [[Court of Bosnia and Herzegovina|the court]] in June. Preliminary results show that Dodik's ally, [[Siniša Karan]] of [[Alliance of Independent Social Democrats|SNSD]], will defeat Branko Blanuša of [[Serb Democratic Party (Bosnia and Herzegovina)|SDS]] with 50.89% of the votes. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/23/barred-bosnian-serb-leader-dodiks-party-wins-presidential-election (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2025 Slovenian assisted dying referendum]]
**[[Slovenia]]ns reject a referendum on a law that proposed legalising [[assisted dying]] for some terminally ill adults with 53.44% voting against. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/majority-slovenians-voted-against-law-assisted-dying-2025-11-23/ (Reuters)]
